resources.string: Write in your own words. NOVA adds the technical details and opens Claude Code with the request ready: you just tap Send.
What do you want to change or add? E.g. “make the dock more transparent”
What is wrong? E.g. “Home freezes when I open Krita” (optional)
Change the accent colour to purple
Add a clock widget to Home
The report is anonymised before it leaves the tablet: no emails, phone numbers, tokens, addresses or names in paths. It is saved in the reports folder of your private repository.
If Claude Code does not show the text, it is on the clipboard anyway: long-press the field and paste. No API key: your Claude subscription is used.
